title: Homotopic filtered maps induce a common filtered cohomology map
statement: For homotopic filtered chain maps a and b and filtrations AF and BF given degreewise by the image filtrations on cohomology, there is a filtration-preserving cohomology map t whose underlying map is both homologyMap a and homologyMap b.

source.place: Lemma 012O (homology-lemma-spectral-sequence-filtered-complex-functorial) together with Definition 012U (homology-definition-filtered-complex-ss-converges), applied to the filtered-complex homotopy calculation

proof.text: Rewrite the supplied filtration steps using their image equations. For each p apply homologyMap to the filtered-step commutative square and use imageSubobjectMap and imageSubobjectMap_arrow to obtain preservation of the image steps. Homotopy.homologyMap_eq identifies the two underlying cohomology maps. This constructs the common filtered map directly, without introducing the cohomologyImage filtration.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 012O and the induced cohomology image filtration; direct image-square construction (C3).

lean.statement:
theorem exists_filteredHomology_map
    (K L : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (G : DecreasingFiltration L)
    (a b : FilteredObject.Hom ⟨K, F⟩ ⟨L, G⟩)
    (H : Homotopy a.hom b.hom)
    (n : ℤ) (AF : DecreasingFiltration (K.homology n))
    (BF : DecreasingFiltration (L.homology n))
    (hAF : ∀ p : ℤ, AF.step p = imageSubobject
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (F.step p).arrow n))
    (hBF : ∀ p : ℤ, BF.step p = imageSubobject
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (G.step p).arrow n)) :
    ∃ t : FilteredObject.Hom ⟨K.homology n, AF⟩
        ⟨L.homology n, BF⟩,
      t.hom = HomologicalComplex.homologyMap a.hom n ∧
      t.hom = HomologicalComplex.homologyMap b.hom n ∧
      ∀ p : ℤ, ∃ lift : (AF.step p : C) ⟶ (BF.step p : C),
        lift ≫ (BF.step p).arrow = (AF.step p).arrow ≫ t.hom
